Penguins EDA

Penguin Size and Mass by Sex and Species

show/hide packages/database code 
library(DBI) # add this
library(duckdb) # add this
library(palmerpenguins) # add this
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dbplyr)

# load penguins data first
penguins_data <- palmerpenguins::penguins
# then connect
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = "my-db.duckdb"
)
# register table
duckdb_register(con, "penguins_data", penguins_data)
# create table
dbExecute(con, "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE penguins AS SELECT * FROM penguins_data")
## [1] 344
# create df 
df <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM penguins") |> na.omit()
show/hide table code 
df %>%
  group_by(species, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
        ends_with("mm") | ends_with("g"),
      \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    ) %>%
  dplyr::collect() %>%
  knitr::kable()
species sex bill_length_mm bill_depth_mm flipper_length_mm body_mass_g
Adelie female 37.25753 17.62192 187.7945 3368.836
Adelie male 40.39041 19.07260 192.4110 4043.493

df %>%
